recipes.name: Classic Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy golden pancakes made from scratch with a hint of vanilla. Perfect for lazy weekend mornings served with butter and maple syrup.

steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and a pinch of salt until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined. A few small lumps are fine — do not overmix.

Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly grease with butter. Pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, about 2-3 minutes, then flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden.
Stack pancakes on plates and serve warm with maple syrup, fresh butter, and blueberries if desired.

recipes.name: Veggie Scrambled Eggs
recipes.description: Light and fluffy scrambled eggs loaded with sauteed bell peppers, spinach, and onions. A quick, protein-packed breakfast ready in minutes.

steps.description: Dice the bell pepper and onion into small pieces. Roughly chop the spinach.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the bell pepper and onion, cooking for 3-4 minutes until softened. Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, season with salt and pepper, and whisk until frothy. Pour over the vegetables and gently stir with a spatula, folding the curds as they form.
Remove from heat while eggs are still slightly wet — they will continue cooking. Serve immediately on warm plates.

recipes.name: Banana Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: A thick and creamy smoothie bowl topped with granola, blueberries, chia seeds, and a drizzle of honey. A refreshing and nutritious way to start the day.

steps.description: Add frozen banana slices, Greek yogurt, and a splash of milk to a blender. Blend until thick and creamy, scraping down sides as needed.
Pour the thick smoothie into a bowl. Arrange granola, blueberries, and chia seeds on top in neat rows.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately while cold and thick.

recipes.name: Classic French Toast
recipes.description: Thick slices of bread soaked in a cinnamon-vanilla custard and pan-fried until golden. A timeless breakfast indulgence.

steps.description: In a shallow bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and a pinch of sugar until smooth.
Dip each slice of bread into the custard, letting it soak for about 15 seconds per side. Allow excess to drip off.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook each soaked slice for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve warm, dusted with cinnamon and drizzled with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Omelette
recipes.description: A light and savory omelette filled with wilted spinach, crumbled feta cheese, and a touch of garlic. Simple, elegant, and satisfying.

steps.description: Heat a small amount of olive oil in a non-stick skillet. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add spinach and cook until just wilted. Remove and set aside.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium-low heat and pour in the eggs. Let them set around the edges, then gently lift to let uncooked egg flow underneath.
When the top is still slightly wet, add the wilted spinach and crumbled feta to one half. Fold the other half over and cook for another 30 seconds.
Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
recipes.description: A New York-style open bagel topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and fresh dill. An elegant yet effortless brunch classic.

steps.description: Slice the sourdough bread and toast until golden and crisp.
Generously spread cream cheese on each toasted slice.
Arrange smoked salmon slices over the cream cheese. Top with thinly sliced red onion, capers, and fresh dill.
Squeeze a bit of lemon juice over the top and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipes.description: Juicy grilled chicken strips wrapped in a flour tortilla with crisp romaine, shaved parmesan, and creamy Caesar dressing. A satisfying lunch on the go.

steps.description: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil. Grill over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through (internal temp 165°F). Let rest 5 minutes, then slice into strips.
Wash and chop the romaine lettuce into bite-size pieces. Shave or grate the parmesan cheese.
Warm the tortillas briefly. Layer romaine, chicken strips, and parmesan on each tortilla. Drizzle generously with Caesar dressing.
Tuck in the sides and roll each tortilla tightly. Cut in half diagonally and serve.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Corn Salad
recipes.description: A vibrant Southwestern salad with black beans, sweet corn, cherry tomatoes, and red onion tossed in a zesty lime-cilantro dressing. Refreshing and filling.

steps.description: Drain and rinse the black beans and corn. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Finely dice the red onion. Chop the cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, combine the black beans, corn, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and cilantro. Pour the dressing over and toss to coat evenly.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for 30 minutes to let the flavors meld. Great on its own or with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Turkey Avocado Sandwich
recipes.description: A stacked sandwich with sliced turkey, creamy avocado, crisp lettuce, and ripe tomato on toasted sourdough. Simple, fresh, and always satisfying.

steps.description: Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden brown.
Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and slice thinly. Season with a pinch of salt.
Layer turkey, avocado slices, lettuce, and tomato on two slices of toast. Season with salt and pepper, then top with the remaining bread slices.
Cut diagonally and serve with your favorite side.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: A velvety smooth tomato soup made with roasted tomatoes, fresh basil, and a touch of cream. Comforting and deeply flavorful.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic, cooking until softened, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat. Add fresh basil leaves and blend with an immersion blender until completely smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream, season with salt and pepper, and heat through for 2 minutes. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Greek Quinoa Bowl
recipes.description: A hearty Mediterranean grain bowl with fluffy quinoa, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, and crumbled feta in a lemon-herb vinaigrette.

steps.description: Rinse the quinoa under cold water. Combine with 2 cups of water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until fluffy. Let stand 5 minutes.
Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, and slice the olives. Dice the red onion finely.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Divide the quinoa between two bowls. Top with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, red onion, and crumbled feta. Drizzle with vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Tender chicken pieces and crisp broccoli tossed in a savory-sweet soy and ginger glaze, served over steamed white rice.

steps.description: Whisk together soy sauce, honey, minced ginger, minced garlic, and sesame oil in a small bowl. Set aside.
Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Heat olive oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add chicken and cook until golden and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the broccoli florets and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the teriyaki sauce, and toss everything together for 1 minute until glazed. Serve over steamed white rice.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: A rich and hearty Italian meat sauce simmered with tomatoes, garlic, and herbs, tossed with al dente spaghetti and topped with parmesan.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until well browned, about 6-7 minutes. Drain excess fat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the pot. Cook for 3-4 minutes until softened and fragrant.
Pour in the marinara sauce, add dried basil, salt, and pepper. Stir well, bring to a simmer, and cook on low for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss the spaghetti with the Bolognese sauce, adding a splash of pasta water if needed. Serve topped with freshly grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken breasts marinated in bright lemon, fresh thyme, and garlic, then grilled to juicy perfection. Pairs beautifully with roasted vegetables.

steps.description: Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, minced garlic, chopped thyme, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Place chicken breasts in the marinade, turning to coat. Let marinate for at least 15 minutes (or up to 4 hours in the refrigerator).
Preheat grill to medium-high. Grill the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F and grill marks are visible.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with a fresh squeeze of lemon and your choice of vegetables.

recipes.name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
recipes.description: Succulent shrimp simmered in a fragrant coconut-curry sauce with garlic and ginger. Served over fluffy jasmine rice for a comforting weeknight dinner.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and diced onion. Cook for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Add curry powder and stir for 30 seconds. Pour in the coconut milk and diced tomatoes, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the shrimp to the sauce and cook for 4-5 minutes until pink and curled. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the curry over steamed jasmine rice. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Roasted Asparagus
recipes.description: Oven-baked salmon fillets seasoned with lemon, garlic, and thyme alongside tender roasted asparagus. A healthy, elegant dinner in under 30 minutes.

steps.description: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place salmon fillets on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, squeeze lemon juice over the top, and season with minced garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Trim the woody ends of the asparagus. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and arrange around the salmon on the baking sheet.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and the asparagus is tender. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos with Fresh Salsa
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef loaded into warm corn tortillas and topped with fresh salsa, diced avocado, and a squeeze of lime. A crowd-pleasing taco night favorite.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until browned. Season with cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Dice the tomatoes, red onion, and cilantro. Toss together with a squeeze of lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Heat corn tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame for about 30 seconds per side until pliable.
Fill each tortilla with seasoned beef, top with fresh salsa and diced avocado. Serve with lime wedges and sour cream on the side.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Luxuriously creamy arborio rice slowly stirred with sauteed mushrooms, white wine, parmesan, and a touch of thyme. Pure Italian comfort food.

steps.description: Warm the vegetable broth in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer.
In a large heavy-bottomed pot, heat olive oil and butter over medium heat. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until golden, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.

In the same pot, add the diced onion and garlic, cooking until soft. Add the arborio rice and stir for 1-2 minutes until the grains are translucent at the edges. Pour in the white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding the next. This takes about 18-20 minutes.
Stir in the cooked mushrooms, parmesan, and remaining butter. Season with salt, pepper, and thyme. The risotto should be creamy and flow slowly when spooned.

recipes.name: Hummus and Veggie Sticks
recipes.description: Creamy hummus served with crisp carrot, celery, and cucumber sticks. A simple, healthy snack that is always ready when you are.

steps.description: Wash and peel the carrots. Cut the carrots, celery, and cucumber into sticks about 3 inches long.
Spoon hummus into a small bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and arrange the veggie sticks around it for dipping.

recipes.name: Apple Peanut Butter Bites
recipes.description: Crisp apple slices spread with peanut butter and topped with a sprinkle of granola and honey. A sweet-salty snack that kids and adults both love.

steps.description: Core the apples and cut into thick rounds or wedges.
Spread peanut butter on each apple slice. Top with a sprinkle of granola and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Cheese and Crackers Board
recipes.description: A simple snack plate of sharp cheddar cheese cubes paired with whole grain crackers and crisp apple slices. Perfect for an afternoon pick-me-up.

steps.description: Cut the cheddar cheese into bite-size cubes.
Arrange the cheese cubes, crackers, and sliced apple on a plate or board.

recipes.name: Trail Mix Energy Balls
recipes.description: No-bake energy balls packed with rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, dark chocolate chips, and almonds. A grab-and-go snack full of sustained energy.

steps.description: In a large bowl, mix together the rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, dark chocolate chips, and chopped almonds until a sticky dough forms.
Refrigerate the mixture for 15 minutes to make it easier to handle.
Scoop about 1 tablespoon of mixture and roll into balls between your palms. Place on a parchment-lined tray.
Refrigerate the energy balls in an airtight container. They keep for up to a week.

recipes.name: Caprese Skewers
recipes.description: Cherry tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil leaves threaded onto skewers and drizzled with balsamic glaze. An elegant bite-size snack for any occasion.

steps.description: Halve the cherry tomatoes if desired. Cut the fresh mozzarella into bite-size cubes. Pick fresh basil leaves.
Thread a cherry tomato, a basil leaf, and a mozzarella cube onto each skewer. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Arrange on a plate, drizzle with balsamic glaze and a light drizzle of olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Guacamole with Tortilla Chips
recipes.description: Chunky homemade guacamole made with ripe avocados, lime, cilantro, and a kick of red onion. Best enjoyed fresh with crispy tortilla chips.

steps.description: Halve the avocados, remove pits, and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Mash with a fork to your preferred consistency — chunky or smooth.
Stir in diced red onion, chopped cilantro, diced tomato, lime juice, salt, and pepper. Mix gently to combine.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips on the side. Press plastic wrap directly on the surface to prevent browning if storing.
